card.title: JUNKERS JU 188 E
card.flavorText: The Junkers Ju 188 was German medium bomber used by the Luftwaffe in WWII. A few versions were made and it was a perfect example of the "bullet nose" design that most German bombers had from Heinkel He 111P and onwards. The Ju 188 was a high performance aircraft but it appeared too late to make any significant impact on the war. Only 1,234 of the Ju 188 were built,  and this was both due to tactical and logistical reasons, the Luftwaffe focusing more on building fighters and the effect the heavy Allied bombing had on German industries.
